text: Faster Compress 是适用于 DSH Web 的上下文压缩插件：它在会话继续工作时后台准备摘要，并在安全步骤边界应用。它沿用当前模型和凭据，保留准备期间新增的消息；准备失败或失效时回退原生压缩。插件还提供压缩历史界面，可查看摘要、状态、耗时及 token 用量。适合长对话和频繁工具调用；默认无需新增 API Key，历史记录保存在本机。

Faster Compress prepares context summaries in the background while DSH sessions continue, then applies them at a safe step boundary. Failed preparation falls back to native compaction. Compaction History shows summaries, status, timings, and token usage. No new API key is required by default.
想让长对话压缩时少停顿一会儿。

Faster Compress 的功能「后台准备摘要」：达到准备阈值后，在主任务继续推进时启动摘要生成；摘要先暂存，不会立刻改写会话。
Faster Compress 的功能「安全边界应用」：摘要就绪后，在下一安全步骤边界提交，并重新校验目标上下文；准备期间追加的消息可保留。
Faster Compress 的功能「原生压缩回退」：准备结果失败、失效或预算不可用时，转用 DSH 原生压缩路径；手动压缩仍由继承的后端处理。
Faster Compress 的功能「压缩历史」：在会话界面查看摘要、应用状态、错误、耗时和用量记录；设置可隐藏标签页，记录仍保存在本机。
Faster Compress 使用前须知：压缩历史会在本机保存摘要和原文摘录，隐藏历史标签页不会停止记录；清理记录需停止 DSH 并删除对应目录。
How can I see why a context summary was skipped or discarded?

dsh-faster-compress README · Faster Compress：**让上下文摘要提前准备，少打断一次正在推进的工作。**

中文 · [English](README.en.md)

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 提供**后台上下文压缩**，减少长任务中停下来等摘要的时间，并通过压缩历史查看结果、耗时和用量。

dsh-faster-compress README · 安装，只填一个包名：打开 DSH 侧边栏的 **插件 → 添加插件**，输入：

```text
dsh-faster-compress
```

点击安装，完成后重新启动 DSH。**默认即用，无需 API Key，也不用编辑 YAML。**

已验证 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2**，需要 **Node.js ≥ 22.19**。它沿用当前对话的模型和已有凭据；摘要、预热请求仍按模型服务的规则计费。

<details>
<summary>只用命令行？</summary>

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-faster-compress
```

然后重新启动 `dsh web`。桌面端请使用应用内的“添加插件”。

</details>

dsh-faster-compress README · 装上后，改变了什么？：- **边工作，边准备。** 达到准备阈值后，后台生成摘要，主任务在安全余量内继续推进。
- **准备好，就应用。** 在下一次模型请求前替换上下文，保留期间新增的消息；正常回合结束后也会保留摘要，供下一轮校验复用。
- **失败时有兜底。** 摘要失败或失效时回退原生压缩，仍可使用 `/compact`。

dsh-faster-compress README · 压缩历史：打开会话顶部的 **压缩历史**，即可查看：

- **内容与状态**：摘要、原文摘录、是否已应用，以及失败原因。
- **耗时**：后台准备、压缩等待与应用后的首输出时间。
- **用量**：压缩前后的实测输入 token，以及摘要请求和缓存用量。

支持搜索、筛选、复制，并跟随 DSH 主题。

dsh-faster-compress README · 设置：进入 **插件 → 已安装 → 更快压缩 · Faster Compress**，修改后保存即可生效，无需重启。

| 设置 | 默认值 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 后台准备时机 | **100%** | 摘要经常来不及时可调低；此比例相对于准备阈值，并非上下文容量 |
| 预热新上下文 | **关闭** | 可选的额外请求，适合服务有余力且能复用缓存时尝试 |
| 显示压缩历史标签 | **开启** | 显示或隐藏会话中的历史页 |

通常保持默认即可。高级选项可调整输出预留、安全余量和并发数；升级保留已有设置。

DS Bot 兼容：由 ds-bot 接管压缩的会话自动跳过后台准备和预热，已有准备结果会丢弃；压缩交由 DS Bot 管理。同一预设下的普通会话仍使用加速。自动检测，无需额外配置。

dsh-faster-compress README · 使用须知：- 适合长对话和频繁工具调用。后台摘要仍占用模型资源并按服务商规则计费，不能保证消除所有等待。
- 未应用的摘要只保存在内存中。重启后会重新准备，或回退原生压缩。
- 历史会在 `$DSH_HOME/data/faster-compress/traces/` 保存摘要与原文摘录。隐藏标签页不会停止记录；清理这些副本时，先停止 DSH，再删除该目录。

[中文](README.md) · English

**Background context compaction** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Reduce pauses for summaries during long tasks, and inspect results, timings, and token usage in Compaction History.

dsh-faster-compress README · Install with one package name：Open **Plugins → Add plugin** from the DSH sidebar and enter:

```text
dsh-faster-compress
```

Install, then restart DSH. **The defaults are ready to use. No new API key or YAML editing.**

Verified with **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2**; requires **Node.js ≥ 22.19**. It uses the conversation's model and existing credentials. Summary and warm-up requests remain subject to your provider's billing.

<details>
<summary>Using the command line?</summary>

dsh-faster-compress README · Install with one package name：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-faster-compress
```

Then restart `dsh web`. For the desktop app, use its Add plugin screen.

</details>

dsh-faster-compress README · What changes?：- **Prepare while work continues.** Background summaries start at the preparation threshold; the main task continues within safe headroom.
- **Apply when ready.** A ready summary is applied before the next model request, preserving messages added during preparation. Normal turn completion retains it for reuse on the next turn.
- **Keep the native fallback.** If preparation fails or becomes invalid, stock compaction remains available. `/compact` still works.

dsh-faster-compress README · Compaction History：Open **Compaction History** at the top of a conversation to inspect:

- Summaries, original text excerpts, application status, and failure reasons.
- Preparation time, compaction waiting, and first-output latency after application.
- Model-reported input tokens before and after compaction, plus summary and cache usage.

Search, filter, and copy records in a view that follows the DSH theme.
dsh-faster-compress README · Settings：Open **Plugins → Installed → Faster Compress**. Changes apply after saving, without a restart.

dsh-faster-compress README · Settings：| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start preparation at | **100%** | Lower if preparation often finishes too late; this is relative to the preparation threshold, not the context window |
| Warm the new context | **Off** | Optional extra request; useful only when the provider has spare capacity and can reuse its cache |
| Show Compaction History tab | **On** | Show or hide the conversation tab |

dsh-faster-compress README · Settings：The defaults suit most use. Advanced options include output reservation, safety margin, and concurrency. Upgrades preserve saved settings.

DS Bot compatibility: sessions whose compaction is managed by ds-bot automatically skip background preparation and warm-up; existing preparations are discarded. DS Bot remains responsible for compaction. Ordinary sessions on the same preset keep acceleration. Detection is automatic; no extra configuration is needed.

dsh-faster-compress README · Before you use it：- Best suited to long conversations and frequent tool use. Background summaries consume model capacity and incur normal provider charges; some waiting may remain.
- Unapplied summaries stay in memory. After restart, the plugin prepares again or falls back to stock compaction.
- History stores summaries and original excerpts in `$DSH_HOME/data/faster-compress/traces/`. Hiding the tab does not stop recording. To remove these copies, stop DSH and delete that directory.
